import sys
from bisect import bisect_right

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    qtty = data[0]
    shts = data[1:1 + qtty]
    ts = data[1 + qtty]

    shts.sort()

    maxspan = 0
    n = len(shts)

    for i in range(n):
        limit = shts[i] + ts
        pos = bisect_right(shts, limit, i)
        cur = pos - i
        if cur < 1:
            cur = 1
        if cur > maxspan:
            maxspan = cur

    print(maxspan)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
